_note: Drafts written by the engineer for Neha and Achal to edit and Aseem to ratify (N1). `words` is what the prompt reads; `check` is what the verifier enforces. Digits are [top, bottom]. regroups lists the allowed counts.

skill_sets.name: 2-digit addition with regrouping
skill_sets.learning_objective: Adds two numbers by columns, making a new ten (or hundred) exactly when a column total reaches ten.

Easy.words: A 2-digit number plus a 1-digit number, with one regroup in the ones. Total under 100.

Medium.words: Two 2-digit numbers with one regroup in the ones. Total under 100.

Hard.words: Two 2-digit numbers with two regroups, ones and tens, so the total passes 100.

Advance.words: A 3-digit number plus a 2-digit number with one or two regroups. The child must line up the shorter number.

skill_sets.name: 2-digit subtraction with exchange
skill_sets.learning_objective: Subtracts by columns, exchanging one ten for ten ones exactly when the ones column needs it.
philosophy: The larger number is always on top. Never write a subtraction the child cannot do.

Easy.words: A 2-digit number minus a 1-digit number, with one exchange.

Medium.words: A 2-digit number minus a 2-digit number, with one exchange.

Hard.words: A 3-digit number minus a 2-digit number, with one exchange. The child must line up the shorter number.

Advance.words: A 3-digit number minus a 3-digit number, with one or two exchanges. No zero anywhere in the top number.

skill_sets.name: 3-digit addition with regrouping
skill_sets.learning_objective: Adds 3-digit numbers by columns with one or more regroups, carrying into the correct column each time.

Easy.words: A 3-digit number plus a 2-digit number with one regroup.

Advance.words: A 4-digit number plus a 3-digit number with two or three regroups.

skill_sets.name: 3-digit subtraction across zero
skill_sets.learning_objective: Exchanges across a zero: takes a hundred, turns the zero into nine tens and ten ones, and keeps every column's value right.
philosophy: The larger number is always on top.

Easy.words: Two 3-digit numbers with one exchange and no zero in the top number. A warm-up before zeros.

Medium.words: Two 3-digit numbers where the top number has a zero in the tens, and the child must exchange across it.

Hard.words: Two 3-digit numbers across a zero, with two exchanges.

Advance.words: Two 4-digit numbers across zeros, with two or three exchanges.
